title: 'AI Cannot Feel Personal Loss': Javed Akhtar On Why Artificial Intelligence May Struggle To Write Great Poetry
description: At Mumbai LitFest 2026, Javed Akhtar discussed whether AI poses a threat to poetry during a session launching Three Masters. Speaking with Sumantra Ghoshal, he said AI could handle practical tasks but lacked the personal experiences that shape creative writing. Akhtar cited grief, heartbreak and rejection as human experiences that give poets an emotional repertoire machines cannot yet replicate.
